g.text: Movement-stage preference and response direction differ across regions

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #59687a

g.text: Filled bars are preferred-stage excitation; outlined bars below zero are suppression. Stars test the training-defined direction in 16 untouched test trials (one-sided Wilcoxon, Holm across 12 groups).
